cells.evidence: SIMULATED: resamples of a MEASURED pool; each row carries its budget class
cells.truth: pool truth of the row's own construct

constructs.agreement: label-free agreement with the uncompressed reference: nDCG@k against the uncompressed index's own top document. It is not a measure of retrieval quality
constructs.labels: labelled retention: nDCG@k against the dataset's labels

full_pool.note: P0 given the whole pool once, each query once, in stored order. A single realisation with no truth to be checked against.

method_c.choice: smallest stored size among the rejected; ties by fewer vectors, then earlier position
method_c.multiplicity: fixed-sequence testing inside each chain, in the chain's own order

seeds.sampling: first n entries of numpy.random.default_rng(seed).integers(0, N, size=3600)

n_star.evidence: SIMULATED; each row carries the class of the budget that decides it
